description: Ahlfors-Grunsky conjectured the hexagonal lattice gives the extremal Bloch constant. Baernstein-Vinson proved local minimality among lattice coverings. Connects to circle packing and crystallography.
mathematical_formalization: B = B_{f_AG} conjectured = 1/sqrt(1+sqrt(3)) * Gamma(1/3)*Gamma(11/12)/Gamma(1/4) ~ 0.4719. Baernstein-Vinson: second variation >= 0 for lattice class variations.
implementation_hypothesis: Compute Ahlfors-Grunsky function via Weierstrass P-function. Perturb lattice parameters and verify local minimality numerically.
experiment_seed: Compute B_{f_AG} to 50+ digits. Perturb tau near e^{i*pi/3}. Plot B_f(tau). Verify local minimum.
